scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.dev:frontend: node init && npm run dev --workspace frontend
scripts.dev:backend: node init && npm run dev --workspace backend
scripts.build: node init && npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.start: node init && npm run start --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
